NBCL Mobile App

Banking that moves with you.

Check balances, transfer money, top up and pay bills anytime, anywhere. Free to download for iPhone and Android.

Available

24/7

What you can do

Everything you need, right on your phone.

Check your balance

See real-time balances and transaction history for all your linked accounts.

Transfer money

Move money between your own accounts, to other NBCL accounts and to other banks in PNG.

Top up

Buy Digicel and Vodafone top-ups in seconds.

Pay bills

Pay your bills quickly and securely, wherever you are.

Manage your cards

Block your card instantly if it's lost or stolen.

Bank from overseas

Use the app wherever you have internet. Get your OTP by email or WhatsApp if you don't have your PNG SIM.

Get started

Set up in a few minutes.

1

Download the app

Get the NBCL Mobile App free from the App Store or Google Play.

2

Register

Tap Self Register and identify yourself with your account number or customer ID and date of birth.

3

Verify

Choose WhatsApp, email or SMS to receive a 6-digit one-time password (OTP), then enter it.

4

Create your password

Set a strong password and you're ready to bank. You'll also get a welcome email.

You need an active NBCL account, to be 18 or over, and a compatible phone with internet access. Prefer help in person? Visit any branch.

Safe and secure

Built to protect you.

  • One-time passwords (OTP) confirm it's really you
  • Your login locks after three wrong password attempts
  • Block your card instantly if it's lost or stolen
  • NBCL will never ask for your password, PIN or OTP
Scams & security

Questions

Mobile App FAQs

I forgot my password. What do I do?+

Tap Forgot Password on the login screen and follow the prompts to reset it securely. You can also visit any branch for help.

What happens if I enter the wrong password?+

After three wrong attempts your login is locked. Follow the prompts to reactivate it, or call (+675) 301 5480.

I entered the wrong OTP.+

Request a new OTP and try again, using the most recent code you received. OTPs expire after a short time for your security.

Can I use the app overseas?+

Yes. The app works anywhere with internet. If you don't have your PNG SIM, choose to receive your OTP by email or WhatsApp.

What are the daily limits?+

Transfer and top-up limits depend on your account. See the Digital & Channel Limits on our Forms & documents page.
